body.name: G_H^{\mathrm{ord}},\ \Omega_H^{\mathrm{ord}},\text{ and }\mathfrak O_H(p)
body.construction: For \(v\in\mathcal W_H\), set \(\operatorname{Pred}_H(v)=\{a\in\mathcal W_H:a\prec_H v\}\). The single maximal graph \(G_H^{\mathrm{ord}}\) contains every \(a\to v\) with \(a\in\operatorname{Pred}_H(v)\) and every bidirected pair of distinct observed vertices. Its finite raw complete-signature domain is \(\Omega_H^{\mathrm{ord}}=\prod_{v\in\mathcal W_H}\{0,1\}^{\{0,1\}^{\operatorname{Pred}_H(v)}}\). Draw one common latent \(U^{\mathrm{ord}}=\xi\) with arbitrary mass \(\rho\in\Delta(\Omega_H^{\mathrm{ord}})\), and recursively generate \(V_v=g_{v,\xi}((V_a)_{a\in\operatorname{Pred}_H(v)})\) in increasing time order. Define \(P_H^{\mathrm{ord}}(\rho)(w)=\sum_{\xi}\rho(\xi)e_w^{\mathrm{ord}}(\xi)\), \(q_H^{\mathrm{ord}}(\rho)=\sum_{\xi}\rho(\xi)d^{\mathrm{ord}}(\xi)\), and \(\mathfrak O_H(p)=\{\rho\in\Delta(\Omega_H^{\mathrm{ord}}):P_H^{\mathrm{ord}}(\rho)=p\}\). The unrestricted law \(\rho\) belongs only to this complete-latent comparator; it is not asserted to respect any missing bidirected edge of a sparse refinement.
